description: You and three neighbors (Johnsons, Patels, Maria) are organizing a joint yard sale. Create a tracking spreadsheet to manage items, pricing, and calculate fair proceeds distribution. The spreadsheet needs: (1) Headers: Item, Owner, Price, Status, Notes in row 1. (2) At least 12 data rows with realistic yard sale items distributed across all four owners (You, Johnsons, Patels, Maria), with prices between $1-$75. (3) A summary section starting around row 17 with 'PROCEEDS SUMMARY' header, individual owner earnings (using formulas to sum each owner's items), and a grand total. Format headers as bold with background color, price columns as currency, and adjust column widths for readability. Save when complete (Ctrl+S).
